title: Red Fort, Delhi
summary: The Red Fort is the palace fort that the Mughal emperor Shah Jahan built in Delhi after moving his capital from Agra. Its red sandstone walls enclose an area of 656 by 328 metres and rise to 23 metres. Construction began in April 1639 and finished in 1648 as part of building Shahjahanabad.

uncertainty.note: ICOMOS gives construction begun in April 1639 and completed in 1648.

as_recorded.value: begun in April, 1639 and completed in 1648
In 1639, Shah Jahan decided to move his court from Agra to Delhi
